pageSubtitle: Your Certified VAG Ecosystem Partner – Built in Syria, Operating at Global Standards
storyParagraph1: V-POWER TUNING was founded in Homs, Syria, with a clear vision: to bridge the gap between the global standards of the VAG Group and the regional market. We recognized that VAG owners and workshop investors alike lacked a single, trusted partner who could deliver factory-grade solutions — from genuine parts to full workshop enablement — all under one roof.
storyParagraph2: What started as a specialized service center has grown into a comprehensive ecosystem. Today, we serve two distinct audiences with equal expertise: individual vehicle owners seeking authentic parts, specialized maintenance, and performance tuning — and investors looking to establish or upgrade certified VAG service centers with complete infrastructure, software, training, and AI-powered management systems.
visionText: To become the leading certified VAG ecosystem partner in the region — expanding our footprint beyond Syria while maintaining the highest standards of quality, transparency, and customer satisfaction.
missionText: To empower the VAG community — drivers and businesses alike — by delivering integrated, certified, and AI-enhanced solutions that meet international standards, right here in the region.

extraSections.title: Our Team
items: Behind V-POWER TUNING is a team of highly experienced engineers, technicians, and specialists who share a common passion for the VAG Group. Our certified professionals combine decades of hands-on experience with continuous training on the latest official diagnostic tools, software, and manufacturer procedures.

We don't just fix cars — we understand them inside out. From engine calibration to structural repairs, from workshop design to talent development, every member of our team is committed to delivering excellence at every level.

extraSections.title: Our Commitment
items: Whether you're a VAG owner bringing your car in for maintenance, an investor building a new workshop, or a technician seeking certification — we treat every relationship with the same level of dedication and professionalism. Our promise is simple: World-class VAG expertise, delivered locally — with integrity, precision, and a relentless commitment to your satisfaction.

extraSections.title: Why V-POWER TUNING?
items: Certified Excellence – Every service, product, and training program we offer meets official manufacturer standards.
AI-Powered Solutions – We integrate artificial intelligence to deliver faster diagnostics, smarter talent evaluation, and data-driven business insights.
End-to-End Capability – From a single spare part to a fully equipped workshop — we do it all.
Local Roots, Global Standards – Based in Homs, we bring international-level expertise to the regional market.
Passion for VAG – We live and breathe Volkswagen, Audi, Skoda, Seat, and Porsche. It's not just our work — it's our DNA.
